capabilities: Play YouTube videos in a note with picture-in-picture, full screen and speed control
Insert clickable timestamps that jump to the playback moment
Import subscriptions and collect new videos in an Inbox
Search YouTube and fetch transcripts with most-replayed moments
Sync watch progress and history through the vault
extras: No account, sign-in or payment; requests to YouTube are signed out and no telemetry is sent. The ad-free player relies on undocumented YouTube interfaces and can stop working until the plugin updates, falling back to YouTube's own player, which may show ads. No offline downloads, and pop-out windows are not supported. Hub data lives in a hidden .obsidian/plugins/ytfree/ folder that some sync tools skip.
problem: Watching a YouTube video and writing notes about it means switching apps, and Obsidian has no built-in way to play a video and jump back to a moment from a note.

relations.evidence: Watch YouTube inside Obsidian, without the ads
import templates/webclipper-ytfree.json. It fires on any youtube.com/watch page.
templates/templater-ytfree.md asks for a link and builds the note.

summary: Embeds an ad-free YouTube player in notes, with clickable timestamps, transcripts, search and a subscriptions hub.
